item.title: Kenya Met Issues Fresh Warning of Flooding in Nairobi Metropolitan Areas
item.description: The advisory comes when more than 23 people have been confirmed dead following the Friday night flash floods that wreaked havoc in the city.

item.title: Massive Job Losses as 51 Companies Close Operations in Kenya
item.description: The latest announcement comes against the backdrop of a heightened crackdown on non-compliant companies to ensure conformity with the Kenyan laws.

item.title: Ruto Okays KDF Deployment, Orders Immediate Changes Over Floods
item.description: Ruto issued the statement while attending the ongoing EAC Summit in Arusha, Tanzania, with the Interior Ministry set to oversee the operations.

item.title: Ministry of Education Sets New Fees for TVETs Starting May
item.description: The changes take effect in the May intake, with parents now being able to budget for known fees amid push and pull over irregular fee hikes at various institutions.

item.title: ODM Asks Supporters to Shun UDA in Fresh 2027 Plot
item.description: The 2027 pre-election primaries and agreements are likely to result in heightened tensions between the two parties over calls for uniform party voting.

item.title: How to Get Kenya Met's Rain & Flood Warning Every 15 Minutes
item.description: The data is relayed directly from the satellite sensors and refreshed in real-time to enable accurate forecasting to ensure users have up-to-date information on weather.

item.title: Siaya Governor Orengo Protests Arrest of Staff Linked to Ruto Visit
item.description: Orengo accused the police of carrying out arbitrary arrests linked to preparations for the President’s tour.

item.title: Ministry of Health Raises Disease Outbreak Alert Amid Ongoing Rains
item.description: The Ministry has cautioned that the rains could lead to contamination of water sources and increased breeding of disease vectors such as mosquitoes.

item.title: List: 15 Nairobi Estates to Experience Water Supply Disruptions After Flooding
item.description: The Nairobi City Water and Sewerage Company has said that the heavy rains and flooding have damaged key distribution pipelines across the county.

item.title: Kenyan Embassy in Qatar Issues Update on Return Flights Amid Middle East Tensions
item.description: The alert followed the suspension of flights in and out of Qatar after the country closed its airspace amid regional tensions.
